advancements.mrpg_lib.root.title: More RPG Content!
death.attack.mrpgc.fatal_poison.teemo: %1$s stepped on a suspicious green and purple mushroom.
death.attack.mrpgc.molten: %1$s is burned by his molten armor.
effect.mrpg_lib.arcane_precision.descrip: Makes targets more vulnerable to Arcane Spell Damage & Crits
effect.mrpg_lib.carve.description: Reduces armor and increases damage taken.
effect.mrpg_lib.collected_soul.descripti: Increases soul spell power per stack.
effect.mrpg_lib.duelists_focus_owner.des: Reduces incoming damage by 25% from attackers who are not marked.
effect.mrpg_lib.duelists_focus_target.de: Other entities deal reduced damage to the attacker who marked you and you receive increased damage.
effect.mrpg_lib.fatal_poison.description: Inflicts damage over time, and can kill both undead and non-undead mobs.
effect.mrpg_lib.frozen_solid.description: Cant move, attack or jump, takes additional damage if hit during active effect.
effect.mrpg_lib.grievous_wounds.descript: Reduced Healing and increased incoming damage.
effect.mrpg_lib.ignited.description: Burns the target, dealing damage over time and reduces healing. The target cannot move or attack.
effect.mrpg_lib.molten_armor.description: Reduces armor, armor toughness and damages the target if it wears armor.
effect.mrpg_lib.sirens_tear.description: Heals a percentage of max health every second, scaling with missing health.
effect.mrpg_lib.soaked.description: Soaking the target with water extinguishing fire, more vulnerable to frost, lightning and water spells.
effect.mrpg_lib.stagger.description: Reduces Armor, Attack Damage & Movement Speed and incapacitates the target.
effect.mrpg_lib.withers_curse.descriptio: Increases Incoming Damage, the amplifier increases with each harmful status effect.
effect.mrpg_lib.zephyrs_speed.descriptio: Increasing the Crit Chance & Movement Speed of the caster.
enchantment.mrpg_lib.stonebloom.desc: Increases earth and nature spell damage you deal.
enchantment.mrpg_lib.typhoon.desc: Increases air and water spell damage you deal.
item.mrpg_lib.upgrade_crystal.warden.app: Earth Wizard and Water Wizard armor
spell.mrpg_lib.arcane_precision.descript: On dealing a critical hit with an active spell, apply a stack of Arcane Precision to the target for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.mrpg_lib.arcane_precision.name: Arcane Precision
spell.mrpg_lib.avalanche_melee.descripti: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} chance to spawn a small avalanche, dealing {damage} damage and inflicting freezing for {effect_duration}.
spell.mrpg_lib.avalanche_melee.name: Avalanche
spell.mrpg_lib.burstcrack.description: Charge a shockwave around you, then release it - the longer the charge, the further it reaches and the harder it hits. Knocks up enemies and deals physical {damage_1} & {damage_2} arcane-damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.burstcrack.name: Burstcrack
spell.mrpg_lib.carve.description: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} chance to stack armor reduction by {bonus2} and increasing incoming damage by {bonus} for {effect_amplifier_cap} times.
spell.mrpg_lib.carve.name: Carve
spell.mrpg_lib.cursed_wither_bolt.descri: On arrow hit: {trigger_chance} chance to inflict wither's curse for {effect_duration} seconds and dealing additional {damage} damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.cursed_wither_bolt.name: Cursed Wither Bolts
spell.mrpg_lib.decapitate.description: Delivers a heavy blow with forward momentum that disables shield and item usage of target.
spell.mrpg_lib.decapitate.name: Decapitate
spell.mrpg_lib.dragon_breath.description: On arrow hit: {trigger_chance} chance to create a dragon breath cloud, dealing {damage} damage per second.
spell.mrpg_lib.dragon_breath.name: Ender Dragon's Breath
spell.mrpg_lib.dragonclaw_melee.descript: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} chance to deal extra {damage} to the target damage and heals the user for {heal} health.
spell.mrpg_lib.dragonclaw_melee.name: Dragonclaw
spell.mrpg_lib.dragonslayers_fury.descri: Healing or buffing allies under {threshold} health, grants them increased critical damage by {bonus} for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.mrpg_lib.dragonslayers_fury.name: Dragonslayer's Fury
spell.mrpg_lib.duelists_focus.descriptio: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} to mark the target, all other entities deal 25%% reduced damage on you and only you deal 25%% increased damage on your marked target.
spell.mrpg_lib.duelists_focus.name: Duelist's Focus
spell.mrpg_lib.elder_guardian_shield.des: On shield block: {trigger_chance} chance to inflict bleeding for {effect_duration} seconds and deal {damage} damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.ender_dragon_shield.descr: On shield block: {trigger_chance} chance to create an explosive burst dealing {damage} damage to nearby enemies.
spell.mrpg_lib.ender_dragon_shield.name: Ender Dragon Shield
spell.mrpg_lib.glacial_shield.descriptio: On shield block: {trigger_chance} chance to freeze nearby enemies for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.mrpg_lib.glacial_shield.name: Glacial Shield
spell.mrpg_lib.glacial_splitter.descript: Defeating Enemies spawns glacial projectiles that deal {damage} damage and freeze enemies for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.mrpg_lib.glacial_splitter.name: Glacial Splitter
spell.mrpg_lib.lightning_strike_melee.de: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} chance to spawn a lightning strike.
spell.mrpg_lib.lightning_strike_ranged.d: On arrow hit: {trigger_chance} chance to spawn a lightning strike.
spell.mrpg_lib.obsidian_shards.descripti: On dealing damage with an active spell, shoot obsidian shards outward in all directions from the target.
spell.mrpg_lib.obsidian_shards.name: Obsidian Shards
spell.mrpg_lib.puncture.description: Charges in a designated direction, striking all enemies.
spell.mrpg_lib.puncture.name: Puncture
spell.mrpg_lib.pyromaniac.description: When dealing spell damage to a burning target, reduce fire spell cooldowns and deal bonus damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
spell.mrpg_lib.reef_arrows.description: On arrow hit: {trigger_chance} chance to inflict bleeding for {effect_duration} seconds and dealing additional {damage} damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.reef_arrows.name: Coral Reef Arrows
spell.mrpg_lib.rimefrost.description: When dealing damage with an active frost spell, spawn a freezing cloud at the target.
spell.mrpg_lib.rimefrost.name: Rimefrost
spell.mrpg_lib.sirens_tears.description: On healing: {trigger_chance} chance to remove a harmful effect and apply regeneration that scales with missing health for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.mrpg_lib.sirens_tears.name: Siren's Tears
spell.mrpg_lib.water_flow.description: When casting a spell, deal water damage and heal nearby allies in a small area.
spell.mrpg_lib.water_flow.name: Water Flow
spell.mrpg_lib.waterbomb_melee.descripti: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} chance to deal {damage} damage around the target.
spell.mrpg_lib.waterbomb_melee.name: Waterbomb
spell.mrpg_lib.wither_pulse_melee.descri: On melee hit: {trigger_chance} inflicts targets in a 90 degree radius with Wither and dealing {damage} damage.
spell.mrpg_lib.wither_pulse_melee.name: Wither Pulse
spell.mrpg_lib.wither_shield.description: On shield block: {trigger_chance} chance to shoot 3 wither skulls dealing {damage} damage and inflicting wither.
spell.mrpg_lib.wither_shield.name: Wither Shield
spell.mrpg_lib.zephyrs_speed.description: On dealing damage with an active spell, gain a stack of Zephyr's Speed for {effect_duration} seconds. Increasing spell crit chance by {bonus} and movement speed by {bonus2}.
spell.mrpg_lib.zephyrs_speed.name: Zephyr's Speed
